chronology.text: On 1 September 2024, plaintiff leased Unit 4C of the Dona Amparo Building in Kapitolyo, Pasig City to defendant at a monthly rent of PHP 33,000.00.
The last rental payment was received on 6 June 2025. Rentals for July 2025 to May 2026, totalling PHP 396,000.00, remain unpaid.

On 15 April 2026, plaintiff served a notice to pay and vacate giving fifteen days from receipt. The registry return card shows delivery in the fourth week of April 2026 with a signature reading N. Ilagan.
The parties appeared before Barangay Kapitolyo on 12 and 19 May 2026 without settlement, and a certification to file action was issued on 26 May 2026.
